job.text: .M.S. _Agamemnon_. So all was over. We could dream of an unknown Land's End no more. Our only regret, an endurable one now, was that we had not carried out our original plan of staying some days there--tourist-haunted, troubled days they might have been, but the evenings and mornings would have been glorious.
